rewrite_classes: terminal diagonal phase -> discard or classical phase frame
D4 gauge conjugation -> conjugate routing tables and syndrome labels
affine triplet -> one 1-of-3 decoder from one trit
binary rank conversion -> defer to archive/export/reset
global ternary negation -> trit-label inversion when downstream is covariant
exact_example: Deleting two terminal M36 SWAPs removes six physical CNOT gates while preserving the branch.
new_architecture_rule: No operation is a physical gate until it changes a future observable in every permissible frame representation.
claim_boundary: Each rewrite is exact under its stated condition. This ledger is not a claim that arbitrary phases, permutations, or non-Clifford operations are always free.
